summary: Two platform controls need remediation before this environment is treated as production-ready.

sections.heading: Identity
sections.summary: Moving to managed identities removes credential handling from the deployment path.
actions: Use system-assigned or user-assigned managed identities.

sections.heading: Network exposure
sections.summary: The network check could not complete, so the public posture still needs an explicit decision.
actions: Disable public access or justify the public posture explicitly.
